items.title: What Is CVS Health (CVS) Signaling With Its Faster Biosimilar Push?
items.summary: CVS Health (NYSE:CVS) said its CVS Caremark unit is accelerating biosimilar adoption to widen access and manage drug costs. The pharmacy benefit manager is removing Humira from its formularies in favor of lower cost biosimilars for many clients. Caremark is applying a similar approach to Stelara, shifting coverage toward biosimilar options as they become available.
